rugs.ai_description: This is a Persian Kashan rug featuring an intricate medallion center with floral motifs. The composition includes rich tones like red, ivory, and navy, suggesting a vintage character.
This rug features a classic Persian Isfahan design with intricate floral motifs and a refined color palette. The detailed floral borders frame a sophisticated cream field.

This is an antique Persian rug with a pictorial scene featuring intricate natural motifs and a vibrant color palette. The detailed artistry suggests a finely crafted piece with a central pictorial design.

This is an intricately designed Persian Tabriz rug featuring a central medallion and floral motifs, with rich colors and a decorative border.

This rug is an antique Persian piece featuring an intricate floral motif with a medallion center on a red field. The design is accentuated by contrasting navy and ivory details, showcasing traditional craftsmanship.

This is an antique Persian Sultanabad rug featuring a floral motif and intricate borders. The rug combines earthy tones with blue and ivory accents, embodying a traditional, elegant style.

This antique Persian Heriz rug features a striking central medallion with geometric designs, accented by a rich palette of reds, navy, and ivory. The rug’s intricate border and traditional craftsmanship reflect its historical and cultural origins.
This is an antique Persian Oushak rug featuring a medallion center with a floral motif on a red and green field. It has a traditional mood and intricate design.

This is a traditional Persian Tabriz rug featuring a complex floral motif with a rich color palette of navy, red, and gold. The intricate design and craftsmanship highlight its timeless elegance.
